description: This file defines the 'WorkflowStateMachine' class, an entity representing a state machine for workflows within the OrangeHRM system. It includes constants for various actions and flow types, private properties mapped to database columns, and accessor methods for those properties.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachine
classes.description: An entity class representing a workflow state within the OrangeHRM HRM system, with properties for workflow parameters and constants defining various workflow actions and flow types.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the workflow state machine record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the record.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow identifier or name.

methods.name: setWorkflow
methods.description: Sets the workflow identifier or name.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state name associated with this entry.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role associated with this workflow state.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role associated with this workflow state.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with this state transition.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action for this workflow state.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the next state after the action is taken.

methods.name: setResultingState
methods.description: Sets the next state after this action.

methods.name: getRolesToNotify
methods.description: Returns roles that should be notified when this state is reached.

methods.name: setRolesToNotify
methods.description: Sets roles to notify for this state.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority value of this state.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of this state.
